comparison.objective: Switch on a variac at zero and ramp it to 60 V, versus setting and locking a gripper angle.
comparison.physical_skill: Read and turn a dial gradually, including regrasping; no jam-nut counterholding.
comparison.success_condition: Power-on occurs at 0 V, ramp stays at or below 10 V/s and 65 V, and finishes at 60 V.
comparison.reason: Shared angular regulation is generic; the variac tests safe rate-controlled operation, not retained mechanical locking.
